name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv SDKs, created example.py with the quickstart code, and ran it. The API call succeeded and generated a valid 41KB MP3 audio file (MPEG ADTS layer III, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, monaural) from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." using the George voice (JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb) and eleven_v3 model.
deviations: The quickstart example uses `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers, but the sandbox has no audio output hardware. I replaced the `play(audio)` call with code that saves the audio stream to a file (`output.mp3`) instead. This is the only deviation — the core text-to-speech generation worked exactly as documented.

env_ready.evidence: cd /home/daytona && pip install elevenlabs python-dotenv exit=0

configured.evidence: python example.py exit=0 and Audio saved to output.mp3 proves the API key was present and valid

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
